items.control_name: Enforce Shielded VM (Secure Boot & vTPM) on all instances
items.description: All Compute Engine VMs must have Secure Boot, vTPM, and Integrity Monitoring enabled.
items.current_value: 12 of 14 VMs have Shielded VM Secure Boot enabled
items.recommended_value: 100% Shielded VMs with Secure Boot = True
items.remediation_notes: Enable Secure Boot on legacy instances 'vm-legacy-app-1' and 'vm-legacy-app-2'.

items.control_name: Enforce OS Login for SSH Access Management
items.description: Project-wide metadata must enable OS Login (enable-oslogin = TRUE) to eliminate static SSH keys.
items.current_value: enable-oslogin = TRUE at project metadata level
items.remediation_notes: Use OS Login with 2SV for elevated admin access.

items.control_name: Enforce GKE Private Cluster & Authorized Networks
items.description: GKE clusters must be private (no external IP on nodes) with master authorized networks enforced.
items.current_value: Cluster 'prod-gke-01' is Private with Authorized Networks = 10.100.0.0/20
items.recommended_value: Private Cluster = True, Control Plane Authorized Networks restricted
items.remediation_notes: Ensure GKE Control Plane authorized networks do not allow 0.0.0.0/0.

items.control_name: Enforce GKE Workload Identity on all Node Pools
items.description: GKE workloads must use Workload Identity to interact with GCP APIs without node Service Account impersonation.
items.recommended_value: Workload Identity pool enabled on 100% of clusters
items.remediation_notes: Audit pod ServiceAccounts mapped to GCP ServiceAccounts.
